mechanism_narrative: The persistent recovery in WORKPLACES mobility from -28.6 at t-2w to -17.7 at t-0w indicates a return to commuting routines; each further point of workplace recovery adds weekday retail footfall, so RETAIL_REC rises over the next four weeks.

failure_condition: If WORKPLACES continues to rise or stays above -20 for the next 28 days but mean RETAIL_REC over those 28 days is less than or equal to its mean over the prior 28 days, the hypothesis is rejected.
